{{Quote|The pilots are helping me escape from B'nish.|First|<ref name="First Blood (short story)">{{InsiderCite|125|First Blood (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''B'nish''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] [[First]] was held there as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] until her escape around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. The [[B'nishi]] were native to the world.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
B'nish was briefly mentioned in the short story "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]" by [[Christie Golden]]. The exact location of B'nish was not revealed, nor was its designation as a [[City/Legends|city]], [[Planet/Legends|planet]], or some other type of location. However, as the [[Unidentified planet (Vestara Khai)|name of the planet]] on which the majority of "First Blood" takes place is never given, it is possible that the story takes place on B'nish, which was confirmed as a planet in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' and [[2012]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''.
